settings/devFakeHosts.title: Fake hosts
settings/devFakeHosts.body: Populate the host grid with 20 dummy PS5s to preview the layout. Display-only — never saved and never connectable.

settings/simulateUpdate.title: Simulate update
settings/simulateUpdate.body: Trigger the update prompt with a developer-simulated build to exercise the download / verify / install flow without a real release.
